subject.title: Stale .jsonl.lock + stuck typing indicator after EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError on parallel subagent fan-out

question: Which recovery contract should own this cluster: tolerate benign session rewrites, durable suspended subagent completion delivery, requester typing teardown, terminal lock cleanup, or a broader serialized/session-lifecycle policy?
rationale: The remaining symptoms cross session fencing, subagent delivery, typing state, and lock cleanup, and related open PRs already encode different partial recovery choices that automation should not sequence independently.

options.title: Sequence focused fixes
options.body: Land or revise the focused fence and message-loss PRs, then add the narrow typing/discard and terminal-lock proof needed to close this issue.

options.title: Limit scope to lock recovery
options.body: Keep only retained-lock cleanup as the supported recovery and explicitly reject durable replay or typing teardown changes for this cluster.

options.title: Pause for lifecycle design
options.body: Hold the related PRs behind a broader maintainer design for serialized sessions, delivery durability, and typing cleanup contracts.

recommendation.title: Sequence focused fixes
recommendation.body: Land or revise the focused fence and message-loss PRs, then add the narrow typing/discard and terminal-lock proof needed to close this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the broadest recent history across subagent registry, session lock, and typing lifecycle surfaces that need sequencing.
